title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the tennis match between Annika Kannan and Yuzuha Negishi in the W15 Antalya, Qualifying, originally scheduled for November 16, 2026 at 1:30AM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Annika Kannan' if Annika Kannan advances against Yuzuha Negishi.

This market will resolve to 'Yuzuha Negishi' if Yuzuha Negishi advances against Annika Kannan.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by November 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the International Tennis Federation (ITF). A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
